title: BioViL
paper_title: Making the Most of Text Semantics to Improve Biomedical Vision-Language Processing
core_mech: 以放射报告专用 CXR-BERT 提升文本语义，再联合学习检查级图文对比与短语–视觉 patch grounding。
core_mech_en: Pairs a radiology-specialized text encoder (CXR-BERT with RSM masked pretraining) with joint global and local patch–phrase contrastive alignment.
input_desc: 胸部 X-ray 与对应放射报告/短语
input_en: Chest radiograph + radiology report findings/impression text
output_desc: 具备报告语义与局部 grounding 能力的胸片表征
output_en: Negation- and clinical-syntax-aware visual-linguistic embeddings and local phrase grounding maps

source.title: BioViL
notes: Microsoft's HI-ML multimodal toolbox provides BioViL inference/examples and links the ECCV 2022 paper. Training-data access and pretrained-weight terms are separate.
The upstream repository is archived. Pin and isolate its legacy dependencies before attempting the original workflow.

gaps: The official BioViL implementation is in Microsoft hi-ml. Its image encoder, clinical language model and original pretraining stages have not been integrated into this CPU lab.
